title: EdhocResponder missing ZeroizeOnDrop impl
description:
File: crates/oscore/src/edhoc/responder.rs
Line: 137
Category: zeroization

## Description
EdhocResponder implements Zeroize but NOT ZeroizeOnDrop. When the responder is dropped (e.g., goes out of scope normally or during stack unwinding), privkey, eph_secret, and state fields are NOT automatically zeroized. Compare to initiator.rs line 139 which has 'impl ZeroizeOnDrop for EdhocInitiator {}'.

## Fix
Add 'impl ZeroizeOnDrop for EdhocResponder {}' after the Zeroize impl block (after line 144).
